fields.why: Tables 2-3 give aPRs for 4-level income, education and nights-homeless (SES) against a Ref level; Table 1 shows food insecurity, homelessness and care measures as row percentages across age and race groups.
SES from the multi-level aPR rows; age (4 groups) and race (5 groups) from Table 1, where outcomes are measured per group (row %), so this is not composition.
SES levels are tested only against Ref (no joint or trend test; the 'decreased as nights increased' claim has no trend test). Age and race values in Table 1 have no tests.
